executionWaves.label: Resolve unclassified database-only evidence identities
prerequisites: Verify the named work from an authoritative source before promotion.
Do not copy synthetic or unverified identifiers into seed data.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: Zero unclassified database-only Report, Thesis, or SourceDoc identities.

executionWaves.label: Run the first full-text appraisal and claim-anchor pilot
prerequisites: Use the already verified full-text hash and page/quote anchor as review evidence.
Bind the appraisal to a citation for the same target; never infer review fields from metadata.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: Three named-reviewer dispositions pass structural, current-hash, target-binding, and citation-policy checks; external eligibility may remain blocked.

executionWaves.label: Capture evidence-based access dates for externally classified works
prerequisites: Record the actual verification date; never manufacture or bulk-assume dates.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: All externally classified Report, Thesis, and SourceDoc rows have verified access dates.

executionWaves.label: Classify remaining unknown evidence roles
prerequisites: Inspect the underlying work or local artifact.
Keep internal syntheses, composite records, duplicates, and blocked material distinct from external publications.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: Zero unknown Report and SourceDoc provenance rows in the live corpus.

executionWaves.label: Complete the remaining evidence-appraisal corpus
prerequisites: Complete the appraisal pilot and approve its review runbook.
Require full text, reviewer identity, current source hash, same-target basis citation, method, applicability, limitations, and risk of bias.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: Every evidence record has a complete current reviewed or explicit excluded disposition; only conservative-gate reviews can support external claims.

executionWaves.label: Expand claim-level page, section, table, and quote anchors
prerequisites: Define the external-claim denominator for each reviewed work.
Do not treat one anchored claim as complete source coverage.
executionWaves.exitCriteria: Every externally used claim is mapped to an exact evidence anchor and independently passes citation plus appraisal policy.

systemGaps.action: Classify each unknown Report as an external report/article, internal synthesis/register, composite record, or blocked source before applying locator and citation policy.
For externally classified SourceDocs only, replace bare-domain, relative, or malformed values with verified absolute http(s) work-level URLs; syntax validation does not prove availability.
Classify each unknown row as external evidence, internal primary material, internal synthesis, or duplicate before applying locator and citation policy.
Preserve local path or document identity and content hash for internal evidence; do not invent a public URL.
Review shared canonical locator groups for true duplicates, generic landing pages, and likely misbindings before external use; do not auto-correct URLs from titles.
Capture verified ISO access dates from evidence; never backfill dates by assumption.
Complete named, full-text appraisal dispositions in the active model; bind each review to the current source hash and a citation for the same target. Never infer appraisal from metadata.

Add structured methodology/applicability, sample/coverage, limitations, and risk-of-bias fields before causal use, or record a complete current explicit exclusion. Thesis.method alone is not a risk-of-bias assessment; exclusions never authorize external use.

The count is externally qualified records without even one syntactic anchor; zero qualifying records is handled by the appraisal gate, not hidden here. Map every emitted claim to page, section, table, quote, or equivalent evidence; one anchored claim must not mark a record complete.
